name: app.promptscout/website-audit
title: PromptScout Website Audit
description: Free website audit for AI search: checks up to 5 public pages and lists fixes. No account needed.

tools.name: promptscout_start_website_audit
tools.description: Starts a technical audit of up to five public pages of one website. The response is an acknowledgment with an audit reference and no final audit status. While the audit runs, it also has retry_after_seconds, the delay in seconds before the result is expected. promptscout_get_website_audit returns the result for that reference. References expire after seven days. A repeated request_key returns the same audit. Errors return status failed with a code and a summary. The audit checks technical setup: access, indexing and discovery, content and structure, and metadata. It does not measure AI citations or visibility. No account is needed.

website.description: The public HTTP(S) website or domain to audit, such as example.com.

request_key.description: A UUID that identifies this check. The same key returns the same check; a key already used for another website returns an error.

tools.name: promptscout_get_website_audit
tools.description: Reads a website audit by the reference that promptscout_start_website_audit returned. References expire after seven days. While the audit runs, the response has ready false, no final status and retry_after_seconds, the delay in seconds before the result is expected. A finished audit has status success when at least one page was analyzed, even with findings, and failed when no page was analyzed. A successful result has a summary, the evidence date, the number of pages analyzed and attempted, a checklist in priority order and notes. Each checklist fix states the problem, the affected URLs, where to change the HTML or server setting, the change and the reason. The notes name checks that could not be completed and the next step. The result contains no visibility score and does not measure AI citations.

reference.description: The audit reference returned when the audit was started. It expires after seven days.

tools.name: promptscout_get_aeo_geo_guidance
tools.description: A reviewed, static guide to appearing in AI search. It covers ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, AEO versus GEO versus SEO, missing brand mentions, AI crawlers, llms.txt, schema, FAQs, content choices and measurement. With a question ID, it returns a direct answer, short steps, a way to check the result and public sources. With one to three topic IDs, it returns guidance per topic: the evidence needed, actions, checks, limits and sources. With neither, it returns the index of question IDs and topics. Other values return an INVALID_INPUT error. The guide never crawls or scans a website, reads no account and does not measure current rankings or live AI answers.

question.description: One fixed question ID, not free text. For example, appear-in-chatgpt answers 'How do I get cited by ChatGPT?', brand-not-mentioned covers a brand missing from AI answers and measure-visibility covers tracking. It cannot be combined with topics.

topics.description: One to three topic IDs. For example, fair-comparisons covers comparison pages. It cannot be combined with question.
